description: This PHP script generates a hierarchical view of roles in the vtiger CRM system, including functions for retrieving role hierarchy from the database, constructing nested HTML for display, and providing user interface elements for role management (add, edit, delete, move). It outputs either a role tree in a Smarty template or the full role list depending on request parameters.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Recursively constructs HTML for displaying the role hierarchy as a nested list, including controls for adding, editing, deleting, and moving roles.
